content.comment_body: Is it possible to adjust the number of digits shown in the displayed value? For instance, the counter shows 6 digits by default, but my application only uses values from 0 to 100, so I would prefer displaying just 3 digits.
Hello, unfortunately, changing the number of digits displayed is not supported.
Could you provide additional information about the specific programs you wish to connect? Also, what challenges do you encounter when working with more than 3 digits?

Hello [user_name], I encountered a similar issue before. You might find useful resources in this discussion: [url]. In particular, review the fourth post; it contains a solution that worked well for me. You can try adapting it to your needs.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is looking to configure the number of digits shown on a device display, aiming to restrict it to 3 digits because their counter values do not exceed 100. Currently, the interface defaults to 6 digits, which cannot be changed through built-in settings. Other users confirm that direct customization isn't available, though alternative approaches have been discussed in previous forum posts. The inability to set digit count may create unnecessary complexity for limited-range applications.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects configurable display settings to allow adjustment of the number of digits shown, resulting in improved clarity and alignment with the actual value range used in their application.
